facts.statement: Siamosuchus is classified as a goniopholidid mesoeucrocodylian.
facts.quote: Siamosuchus is a genus of goniopholidid mesoeucrocodylian.

facts.statement: The genus Siamosuchus was described by Lauprasert and colleagues in 2007.
facts.quote: Siamosuchus was described by Lauprasert and colleagues in 2007.

facts.statement: Fossils of Siamosuchus were recovered from the early Aptian-aged Sao Khua Formation in eastern Thailand.
facts.quote: Its fossils have been recovered from the early Aptian-aged (Early Cretaceous) Sao Khua Formation of eastern Thailand.

facts.statement: Siamosuchus lived during the Barremian stage, between 125.77 and 121.4 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Barremian to Barremian (125.77 to 121.4 million years ago)

facts.statement: The parent group of Siamosuchus is the family Goniopholididae.
Siamosuchus belongs to the class Reptilia.
It is debated whether Siamosuchus is closely related to the European genus Goniopholis.
facts.quote: Siamosuchus may be closely related to the European genus Goniopholis.

rejected.statement: The known fossil material includes a partial skull, most of the right half of the postcranial skeleton, and some bony scutes.
rejected.quote: It is known from a partial skull, most of the right half of the postcranial skeleton, and some bony scutes.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'a partial skull most of the right half'
